title: Triage alerts from the keyboard
summary: Use the split view to walk the alert queue with j and k, select with x, and escalate an alert into a case with e.

steps.title: Welcome
steps.body:
The alert queue is built for the keyboard: **j** and **k** move, **x** selects, **e** escalates the alert you are on into a case.

You will create a practice alert for the **IrisInitialClient** test customer and escalate it. The last step offers to delete the case it becomes.

steps.title: Open the queue
steps.body: Open **Alerts** in the menu on the left.

steps.title: Fill it in
steps.body: Give it a title and pick the **customer**, a severity, a status and a classification, then click **Create alert**.

steps.title: The split view
steps.body: Switch to the **Split** view: the queue on the left, the alert you are on to the right.

steps.title: Move with j and k
steps.body: Press **j** to move down the queue and **k** to move up. Stop on your practice alert, **[Tutorial] Sign-in from an unusual country**, then click Next.

steps.title: Select with x
steps.body: Press **x**: the alert is selected and the selection bar appears, with the actions for every selected alert (status, owner, merge, close).

steps.title: Escalate with e
steps.body: With your practice alert still the one you are on, press **e**: the escalation form opens.

steps.title: Escalate it
steps.body: The case title comes from the alert, and its IOCs and assets are ticked to come along. Pick a case template if you have one, then click the button at the bottom of the form.

steps.title: Open the case
steps.body: The alert is now case #{caseId}, and the alert shows as escalated in the queue. Open the case.

steps.title: Clean up
steps.body: Case #{caseId} was for practice. Delete it now, or keep it to look around: cases of IrisInitialClient count in no dashboard. The practice alert stays in the queue as escalated.
